title.it: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable Socially Assistive Robots: A Cognitive Architecture for Dietary Guidance
title.en: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable Socially Assistive Robots: A Cognitive Architecture for Dietary Guidance

authors: Luigi D'Arco, Luca Raggioli, Gianni Randazzo, Giovanni De Gasperis, Antonio Chella, Stefania Costantini, Silvia Rossi

description.it: Architettura cognitiva per robot sociali che integra percezione multimodale, ragionamento simbolico, memoria e spiegabilita basata su LLM per il supporto dietetico.
description.en: A cognitive architecture for social assistive robots that combines multimodal perception, symbolic reasoning, memory, and LLM-based explainability for dietary guidance.
